cultural.vision_reason: This is a classic finger-woven/brocaded cotton bedspread with bands of animals, birds, and human figures in bright acrylic-dyed weft brocade — a well-documented Otomi textile type (Tenango-style embroidery/brocade textiles from the Otomi region of Hidalgo, Mexico). The technique, material, and figurative banded design match known Otomi work.

physical.title: bed-cover
physical.summary: Bedspread; made of cotton; four panels of cotton woven on backstrap loom and sewn together; finger-knotted fringe added on sides and bottom; top folded over and hemmed; each panel weft-brocaded with brightly coloured designs in acrylic yarn; border across top and bottom of band of red diamonds with band of blue diamonds above and below; motifs from top to bottom band of animals with flowers and leaves, band of birds with wings outrstretched with flowers and leaves, band of dogs? with flowers and leaves, band of horses? or dragons? with flowers and leaves, band of men and women with flowers and leaves, band of deer with antlers with flowers and leaves, band of peacocks with long tails with flowers and leaves, band of churches, band of profile bird on either side of plant, band of flowers, band of horses, most with riders.
